newsitem.title: USA: PHLX submits recommendations on oversight.
newsitem.headline: PHLX submits recommendations on oversight.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) on Wednesday said a special governance committee had submitted its recommendations for improving the exchange's oversight structure.
Among the recommendations, the committee called for a reduction of the size of the exchange's board of governors to 22 from 30, made up of a majority of non-industry governors.
It also called for periodic continuing education sessions and training for governors, committee members, management as well as legal and regulatory staff at the exchange.
In addition, it called for the exchange to adopt a code of conduct that would apply to all governors, committee members, PHLX officers and employees.

The recommendations are pending approval by the PHLX board of governors, confirmation from the full membership of the PHLX, and approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission, the exchange said.
It said that following SEC approval, it expected the changes to be implemented by the Fall of 1997.
